ticket.title: Washing Machine Repair Request
ticket.description:
Hey, the washing machine isn't spinning when it comes to the end of a cycle with washing inside the washer. No matter the cycle, with clothes in it doesn't spin/drain resulting in powering off the machine and draining it mainly front the front drain pipe. The cycle says at "0:01" minute left indefinitely as it continues to spin, presumably to try and remove the water.

I have cleaned/empited out the front filter and fully drained the machine twice since it started. Both times because the door wouldn't unlock due to water being left in the machine. 

Thanks,
Turner

input.body:
Dear Miles,

Re: Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ6 1ZZ – job ref R/PM041-1

Thank you for your email and for asking Amelia to contact the tenant about the washing machine and the towel rail. We have let the tenant know.

For Amelia's information: the tenant has now tried clearing the drain pump/filter twice, as we advised, and the machine still does not spin or drain. Because the sink spigot was blocked in May 2023, it may be worth checking that first.

When Amelia has visited, please let us know the date and what she found, so we can keep the job record up to date.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
